issue_title: ExceptionRenderer w/ ExceptionDictTransformer unable to handle exception log outside exception handler
issue_body:
When using the `exception` log method outside an exception handler, the `ExceptionDictTransformer` raises an `AttributeError` as it calls `extract`, which does not handle the case where the given exception type is `None`.

While according to the Python docs[^1] this method should only be used from exception handlers, I ran into this issue as the aio-pika (aiormq) library uses it outside an exception handler ([issue](https://github.com/mosquito/aiormq/issues/200)). (I have configured structlog as the formatter for all loggers, using [this](https://www.structlog.org/en/stable/standard-library.html#rendering-using-structlog-based-formatters-within-logging) setup)

Note that the default `_format_exception` formatter handles this case properly, as it handles `(None, None, None)` exc_info[^2].

[^1]: https://docs.python.org/3/library/logging.html#logging.Logger.exception
[^2]: https://github.com/hynek/structlog/blob/e48a553979b00ab580d8ab0e55b5cf96e752a324/src/structlog/_frames.py#L25
---

Reproduction:
```
import structlog
print(structlog.__version__) # 24.4.0
structlog.configure([structlog.processors.dict_tracebacks])
structlog.get_logger().exception("oh no") # AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute '__name__'. Did you mean: '__ne__'?
```
